=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1564-1571 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The success-path cleanup removes `${attempt_prompt_file}` before the `mv` that writes `${EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE}`, so a move failure can delete the only retry state.
  WHY: Both reviewers reported that if `mv "${tmp_output}" "${EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE}"` fails, downstream consumers lose the fallback state and the no-op cascade can misfire.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1199-1201, 1630-1635, 1690-1698 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Best-effort cleanup of `editor_refused.flag` and attempt files can leave stale state across retries or parallel invocations.
  WHY: The reviewers warned that stale refusal state can poison a later clean run or survive until another invocation starts, breaking idempotency.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1688-1700 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The fallback summary heredoc uses an unquoted delimiter and interpolates a local variable, enabling shell expansion.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the written summary can be corrupted, and future fallback content could trigger unintended shell expansion.
- tests/test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py:380-414 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Hardened lockstep assertions contain duplicate break statements from malformed patch context, making the module syntactically invalid.
  WHY: The reviewer said direct script execution would raise a syntax error instead of running the contract tests.
- tests/test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py:38, 415-430 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: REFUSAL_SENTINEL_TEXT is defined but never used in any assertion or helper, so the test repeats the literal inline instead.
  WHY: Both reviewers said the constant adds no test coverage and does not protect the lockstep contract from wording drift.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1483-1491 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The refusal-aware branch emits a new literal that differs from the original warning string expected by downstream parsers and smoke tests.
  WHY: Both reviewers said external tooling that greps for the exact old string will miss the refusal case, violating the additive-only contract.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- tests/test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py:38, 415-430 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: REFUSAL_SENTINEL_TEXT is defined but never used in any assertion or helper; test_refusal_contract_literals_stay_in_lockstep_across_files repeats the literal inline instead.
  WHY: Dead constant adds no test coverage; wording drift in any of the three files would still pass the test while breaking validator/poller lockstep.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1564-1571 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `rm -f "${attempt_prompt_file}"` now precedes the `mv "${tmp_output}" "${EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE}"`.
  WHY: Any mv failure (permission, ENOSPC, concurrent runner) leaves no EDITOR_SUMMARY_FILE but deletes the only copy of the retry state; validator falls back to generic no-op path and downstream poller/Telegram loses refusal-specific signal.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1199, 1630-1635, 1690-1698 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `editor_refused.flag` and `*.attempt_*` files are cleaned best-effort with `2>/dev/null || true`; PREVIOUS_REVIEWS_DIR is reused across retries/continuation dispatches on the same PR branch and across parallel review jobs.
  WHY: Prior refusal leaves stale flag → next clean editor run emits refusal sentinel → EDITOR_NOOP_REFUSAL=true and auto-merge blocked; idempotency of no-op guard is broken.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1688-1700 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Heredoc delimiter is unquoted (`<<__EDITOR_SUMMARY__` not `<<'__EDITOR_SUMMARY__'`), allowing full shell expansion of the body.
  WHY: If tmp_output or a future editor fallback contains `$`, `$( )`, or backticks, the written summary becomes corrupted or executes unintended commands.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1483-1491 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: New refusal-specific `::warning::` literal is emitted alongside (and sometimes instead of) the original generic noop warning.
  WHY: Downstream consumers that grep for the exact original string now miss the refusal case or require pattern updates; violates the additive-only rule.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
